sloka: एकवेणीं दृढं बद्ध्वा गतसत्त्वेव किन्नरी ।आज्ञाप्य तु महाराजो राघवस्याभिषेचन्म् ॥२-१०-९॥
transliteration: ekaveṇīṁ dṛḍhaṁ baddhvā gatasattveva kinnarī ।ājñāpya tu mahārājo rāghavasyābhiṣecanm ॥2-10-9॥

translations.english: The king issued orders for Rama's installation ceremony, and taking leave of his close associates entered the palace. .
